set system host-name PE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols oam cfm version standard.command: set protocols oam cfm version standard
set protocols oam cfm version standard.explanation: Configure the version of OAM CFM as standard.

parameters.name: version
parameters.explanation: OAM CFM version, for example, Standard.

set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.command: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain md1
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.explanation: The command configures a Connectivity Fault Management (CFM) maintenance domain named `[parameter1]` within the OAM protocols in Junos.

parameters.name: maintenance-domain
parameters.explanation: maintain the name of the domain, e.g. md1.

level 3.explanation: The command `level [parameter2]` in Junos sets the syslog logging level to the specified severity (e.g., `info`, `error`, `critical`) for system messages.

parameters.name: level
parameters.explanation: Levels of maintenance range from 0 to 7.

maintenance-association ma1.explanation: The command `maintenance-association [parameter2]` in Junos configures a Maintenance Association (MA) for Ethernet OAM, where `[parameter2]` specifies the MA name or identifier.

mep 31.explanation: The command `mep [parameter3]` in Junos configures a Maintenance End Point (MEP) for Ethernet OAM, where `[parameter3]` specifies the MEP identifier.

parameters.name: mep
parameters.explanation: Maintains the ID of the endpoint.

interface ge-1/0/1.1.explanation: The command `interface [parameter4]` in Junos enters configuration mode for the specified network interface, allowing further configuration of that interface.

direction inward.explanation: The command `direction [parameter5]` specifies the traffic flow direction (e.g., `input`, `output`, or `both`) for applying a filter or policy in Junos configuration.

ais-enable.explanation: The `ais-enable` command in Junos enables Alarm Indication Signal (AIS) generation on a SONET/SDH interface to notify downstream devices of a failure upstream.

ais-interval 60.explanation: The `ais-interval [parameter4]` command in Junos sets the Alarm Indication Signal (AIS) interval to the specified value (parameter4) in milliseconds for SONET/SDH interfaces.

parameters.name: ais-interval
parameters.explanation: The time between AIS messages, in seconds.

vlan 10.explanation: The command `vlan [parameter4]` creates or configures a VLAN with the ID specified by `[parameter4]` in Junos OS.

remote-mep 32.explanation: The command `remote-mep [parameter3]` in Junos configures a remote Maintenance End Point (MEP) for Ethernet OAM, specifying the MEP ID for connectivity monitoring.

parameters.name: remote-mep
parameters.explanation: Remotely maintains the ID of the endpoint.

ccm-receive-enable.explanation: The command `ccm-receive-enable` enables the reception of Continuity Check Messages (CCMs) in Junos, used for monitoring Ethernet OAM (Operations, Administration, and Maintenance) connectivity.

ais-enable.explanation: The `ais-enable` command in Junos enables Alarm Indication Signal (AIS) generation on a SONET/SDH interface to notify downstream devices of upstream failures.

unit 1.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

family inet address 1.1.1.1/32.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: vlan-id

encapsulation vlan-ccc.explanation: Configure the type of envelope for the sub-interface.

set protocols l2circuit neighbor 3.3.3.3.explanation: Configures a Layer 2 Circuit (L2Circuit) neighbor with the specified IP address (`[parameter1]`) for point-to-point pseudowire connectivity.

interface ge-1/0/1.1.explanation: This command configures a Layer 2 Circuit (L2Circuit) by specifying a neighbor device (`parameter1`) and associating it with a local interface (`parameter2`) for pseudowire establishment.

virtual-circuit-id 100.explanation: The L2 circuit is equipped with neighbours, interfaces and virtual circuit ID.

encapsulation-type mpls.explanation: The command `encapsulation-type [parameter3]` sets the encapsulation method for a network interface, specifying the protocol or format used for data transmission.

set protocols mpls interface ge-1/0/2.explanation: Enables the MPLS protocol on the specified interface.

interface lo0.1.explanation: Configure interfaces in the OSPF area.
